report.interpretation: Post hoc mechanism refinement. Each intervention occurs at a materialized native observation boundary. All other arrays, the neural clock, and all synaptic weights/u/w remain unchanged for partial resets. Twelve fixed conditions, full graph, fixed decoder, no added current, no account or profit calculation. Recovering a reset-induced spike is not evidence of better trading.

selection: Most active 18 visual and 48 KC cells, identified DAN/MBON/output cells, plus requested IDs. Layout is grouped by function, not anatomical coordinates. Full graph simulated; full neuron traces in NPZ.
